description: This file defines the 'Tag' class, which represents user-defined labels for books in a book-tracking application. It includes properties, annotations for ORM and JSON serialization, and methods for equality and hashcode.

classes.name: Tag
classes.description: Entity class representing a tag associated with books. It includes a many-to-many relationship with Book, a unique name, and overridden equals and hashCode methods.

methods.name: Tag
methods.description: Constructor initializing Tag with a name.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare Tag objects based on 'name'.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode consistent with equals, based on 'name'.
